notes.title: Final Stages of the game
notes.notes:
Hello!
im once again informing you all on the final version of this game. perhaps the one and final version of the game.
not sure if that's gonna be like that but i have other stuff to do so i cannot fully commit to updating this game, but i'll do my best to keep it as polished and as fun as it can be.

i've done a few changes to the movement [b]A G A I N[/b] and [b]switched some of the buttons for example the left shift was changed to F for the dash[/b]. stuff like these will be changed to better suit the game's universal controls [i]cause im unable to do any custom keybinds for those who wish that was the case, im sorry-[/i]

i've also made a few changes to the levels for the full version for a much longer playtime and some that needed a little extension or added challenge.

i've decided that the game will have 3 modes:
Classic mode - The base game
High Speed mode - A Faster paced version of the game [b]trust me, you'll finish this less than 15 minutes if you already played the classic mode[/b]
Restrict mode - You get to choose what to remove and play the game without those abilities.

here's what you can remove:

-Hyperspeed
-Dash
-Double Jump

removing wallrun will fuck up the game since [b]Some levels require that and without that you're unable to complete it[/b]

Overall it's going pretty well and at the time of writing this I'm working on the final level and the cutscenes, possibly controller support will be added as well.
Although that's quite tough for me to put it on steam since I might need to do all the menus have controller support. Sure i am capable of doing the movement for controllers but menus are new to me for controllers. I'm not saying I'm unable to do it because I sure as heck can with a few tutorials on YouTube (that's how I learned to make games btw).

Other than that I'm having a blast making this game and testing it out! (or playing it for the sake of it >:3)

Adios amigos im outta here-
Ps: bleach be bussin
